campaign.title: Cross-ray hyperbolic-paraboloid decoupling hypothesis map

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use only the primary Demeter--Wu arXiv source for the imported theorem statement. Record theorem numbers, version, quantifiers, norm direction, support, transversality, and rescaling limits. No external theorem is accepted merely from an abstract or analogy.

frozen_target.question: Can Demeter--Wu's bilinear ell^2 or refined bilinear decoupling for the hyperbolic paraboloid be mapped, without changing absolute-value placement or coefficient ownership, to the actual Round-131 variable-modulus top-shell scalar and give a complete exponent below 27/48; if not, what is the first exact missing hypothesis or source-level no-go?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Estimate the literal fixed-centre scalar O_{i,D}^+=sum_r^lit A_i(r) sum_{n>0}^lit W_{i,r}(n), equivalently the residual R_i^res(c)=sum_r^lit A_i(r)R_{i,r}^phys(c), where n=ab'-a'b, the phase is e(cn/(kappa_i b b'))=e(ca/(kappa_i b)-ca'/(kappa_i b')), kappa_1=1 and kappa_2=4, and every primitive lift, threshold, Stieltjes/Mobius coefficient, quarter carrier or chi_4 factor, reciprocal alias, taper, star, cell, sign, and owner is retained. No positive energy, arbitrary-coefficient operator norm, or averaged-centre quantity substitutes for this scalar.
quantities: W=Y^(7/16), D=Y^(1/2), L=Y^(1/6), c asymp Y, |a| and |a'| asymp L, b and b' asymp D
0<n=ab'-a'b lesssim D^2/W=Y^(27/48), with O(1) literal p-lifts for fixed outer ray and n
local phase Phi(u,v)=-cu/(kappa_i v) has det Hess Phi=-(c/(kappa_i v^2))^2 asymp -1 on the top shell
outer coefficients satisfy sum_r |A_i(r)| lesssim D and sum_r |A_i(r)|^2 lesssim D/L
determinant target=D=Y^(24/48+epsilon); after ideal per-ray collapse it still requires cross-ray Y^(-1/16)

completion_criteria: Produce an exact source card for Demeter--Wu arXiv:2505.09037v2, including Definitions 1.2, 1.3, and 1.9 and Theorems 1.6 and 1.10, with every Fourier-support, transversality, localization, incidence, norm, and absolute-value hypothesis.

Derive or refute an explicit affine or smooth coordinate normalization from Phi(u,v)=-cu/(kappa_i v) to the truncated hyperbolic paraboloid, including physical scale R, cap dimensions, Fourier thickness, Jacobians, lattice discretization, and the effect on literal coefficients.

State a legal broad--narrow partition and check quantitative separation in both surface coordinates; treat the accepted same-denominator aligned packets as narrow-ruling controls rather than silently discarding them.
Prove a fixed-centre pointwise bridge from the source's bilinear L4/refined integral estimate, with every localization loss, or name this as the first exact missing hypothesis and price its cost.

Compute the actual coefficient norms after physical Stieltjes/Mobius reassembly and preserve the source theorem's direction of absolute values; no coefficient-blind positive square function may be credited as signed cancellation.
Price every covered stratum against 35/48, 27/48, and 24/48, including narrow, boundary, threshold, star, taper, and owner contributions.
Close under exactly one label: applicable_positive_margin, exact_missing_hypothesis, or source_level_no_go.
Make no global exponent, M9-M1, M9-M2, endpoint, bridge, M9, or quarter promotion.

tasks.target: Audit the primary source https://arxiv.org/src/2505.09037 (v2) and write the exact theorem card for the hyperbolic-paraboloid bilinear ell^2 and refined bilinear estimates. Do not claim project applicability.
required_output: A seven-section primary-source report with direct arXiv citations and no secondary-source dependency.
A theorem card recording definitions, quantifiers, absolute-value placement, Fourier support, localization, wave-packet incidence hypotheses, and permitted rescalings.
An explicit list of conclusions not contained in the source.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

tasks.target: Starting from the exact Round-131 physical scalar, derive the literal phase-surface normalization and project parameter map into the Demeter--Wu framework. Compute R, cap scales, transversality, coefficient norms, broad/narrow pieces, fixed-centre localization losses, owner errors, and the final Y-capacity, or isolate the first exact mismatch.
required_output: An exact coordinate, scale, cap, norm, and owner table from project variables to source variables.
A priced applicable stratum, one exact missing hypothesis, or a source-level no-go.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

tasks.target: Using only the supplied theorem statement and literal scalar packet, independently determine whether the bilinear decoupling estimate implies any fixed-centre signed bound with a strict cross-ray power. Derive the weakest legal implication, test the narrow-ruling aligned controls, and give an exact missing-hypothesis or no-go statement if the implication fails.
excluded_context: all Round-95 through Round-132 nonblind artifacts
required_output: A theorem-level implication or counter-implication with the first invalid inference named exactly.
A hostile aligned-packet and fixed-centre-versus-integral control, with explicit exponent cost where derivable.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

review_seams.requirement: The primary v2 theorem statement, definitions, norm direction, and limitations are recorded without abstract-level extrapolation.
The ratio phase is normalized to a hyperbolic surface with all anisotropic scale and lattice effects explicit.
Broad pairs satisfy quantitative separation in both coordinates; rational rulings and aligned packets are assigned to a separately priced narrow term.
A bilinear L4 or refined integral inequality is not silently converted into a fixed-centre signed scalar estimate or positive-energy substitute.
Physical Stieltjes/Mobius coefficients, characters, variable primitive moduli, thresholds, stars, tapers, cells, signs, and owners survive the map.
Every normalization and uncovered stratum is priced against 35/48, the strict 27/48 persistence threshold, and the 24/48 determinant target.
